name: cz-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in the Czech Republic for tax year 2026, from the Business Corporations Act (90/2012 Coll.), the Public Registers Act (304/2013 Coll.), the Civil Code, the Court Fees Act, the notarial tariff, the Administrative Fees Act and the Accounting Act. Covers the forms (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s., branch, sole trader), the CZK 1 minimum contribution in an s.r.o. with 30% of each cash contribution paid before filing, the CZK 2,000,000 or EUR 80,000 minimum for an a.s., founding by notarial deed, registration by a notary or the regional court (5 working days, then deemed entered), court and notary fees (free court entry and a CZK 2,000 deed for a model s.r.o.), the trade licence, tax registration within 15 days, the beneficial owner entry, filing accounts, and the 2026 change that ends the audit duty for small companies.
